content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the UPTET 2026 Certificate on 07 September 2026.

The certificate is related to the Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test for Primary Level Classes I to V and Junior Level Classes VI to VIII. Candidates can use the official certificate portal to download their certificate.

Important dates

  • Application began: 27 March 2026
  • Registration and examination fee last date: 03 May 2026
  • Correction last date: 08 May 2026
  • Exam date: 02 to 04 July 2026
  • Exam city details: 22 June 2026
  • Admit card: 30 June 2026
  • Answer key: 08 July 2026
  • Result declared: 26 August 2026
  • Certificate released: 07 September 2026

Languages available

UPTET is available in Hindi, English, Urdu and Sanskrit.

How to download the certificate

  1. Open the official UPTET certificate link.
  2. Enter the requested candidate and examination details.
  3. Submit the form to view the certificate.
  4. Download and print the certificate for future use.

Use the official notices and result link below for certificate, result, answer key, admit card, correction and examination updates.
